title: Append-only audit log with size rotation keeping exactly N backups
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag that rotation happens before rather than after an append, or that one oversized entry can exceed max_bytes. Both are the stated contract: pre-append rotation keeps a finished file within the bound, and an oversized entry on an empty file must be written rather than discarded or rotated endlessly.
